name: Cryovolcano🌟
description:
Shots fire a 9-block long and 4.5 block wide cylinder for 9❤️ damage, applying 9 seconds of freezing and burning.

Mythical enchantment discovered on the [term:eclipse][blue]eclipsed[/blue][/term] form of the relic [dark-red]Cerberus[/dark-red]. (Through [blue]Aphelion of Pluto[/blue])
